tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Lists the products mylife.ie can quote (mortgage protection, level term life cover), the accepted limits for amount, term and age, the insurer panel, the regulatory status and the Terms of Business link.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns a plain explanation of a type of cover: life cover or mortgage protection, joint or dual life, or the conversion option. With no slug, lists the guides.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns indicative monthly prices for mortgage protection or level term life cover from every insurer on the mylife.ie panel, for a person living in Ireland, cheapest first. Takes the product, the amount, the term and, for each person, a date of birth (or an age if the date is not known) and whether

tools.name: get_quote_details
tools.description: Returns what mylife.ie holds about each insurer on an earlier quote, by its quoteId: online underwriting, the conversion option, limits and documents.
